name: antigravity-delegate
description: Securely delegate bounded audits, research, testing, and isolated implementation tasks from Codex to Google Antigravity CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Безопасное делегирование задач в Antigravity CLI
interface.longDescription: Codex сохраняет роль оркестратора, а Antigravity выполняет ограниченную задачу в отдельном git worktree и возвращает структурированный результат для обязательной проверки.
defaultPrompt: Use Antigravity Delegate to obtain an independent read-only architecture review and verify every finding.
Use Antigravity Delegate to run a bounded security audit in an isolated worktree without exposing secrets.
Use Antigravity Delegate for an isolated implementation task, then inspect the full diff and run the project checks.
